transcript.message: We’re making our opening bid of 37.5M for Leo Silva.
The situation has shifted, and Eastgate United are also in the mix. You’ll need to match their offer if we’re to move forward.
We’re pushing for a lower fee, and add-ons are now part of the package.
Their bid is far below our valuation, and with Southport Athletic also in the race, they’ll need to raise their offer significantly.
We’re looking for a more competitive deal, with Eastgate United also showing interest.
We’re proposing a 4.5M annual salary with a 5-year contract, which reflects our strong interest and commitment.
We’ve made it clear that we’re not interested in a deal below our expectations.
We’re prepared to consider a deal at 65M plus add-ons, but we need a serious commitment from you.
We’re not holding back on our demands and are ready to finalize this if you’re willing to meet them.
We’re finalizing the fee at 50M with add-ons included, and we need a swift resolution before the deadline.
We’re happy to accept the 5.9M annual salary on a 4-year contract and move forward with the transfer.
